high-dose, but not physiologic, insulin inhibits bradykinin- and cyclopiazonnic acid-induced increases in intracellular calcium concentration and coronary vasodilation in porcine endothelial cells and arteries.

high-dose, but not physiologic, insulin attenuated agonist-induced coronary artery relaxation and inhibited agonist-induced increase in intracellular Ca 21 concentration in coronary endothelial cell, suggesting that hyperinsulinmia might be associated with endothelial dysfunction and coronary artery disease via the derangement of endothelium-dependent functions.
high-dose, but not physiologic, concentrations of insulin inhibit agonist-induced Ca2+ response in porcine endothelial cells and agonist-induced coronary artery relaxation.

the direct effects of insulin in the coronary circulation.
